text:
maria: Postmortem follow-up for recurring p95 spikes on inference-pool-b. Seeing ~4x p95 bursts every 12-18h, tied to large-batch reruns. Proposing temporary SLO tweak + dashboard + playbook. TL;DR: p95 relaxation for 14d while we cap batches. Action items below.
jon: Can you drop the error-budget burn numbers for the last 14 days?
maria: Burned ~9.5% in 14d, three ~2h spikes; projection ~30%/30d if we do nothing.
kevin: I can own the dashboard + alerting. Will add per-model split and a rolling 1h spike annotation. ETA 48h.
ash: I can own the scheduler change (batch caps) and run the canary on pool-b-low first. ETA 72h.
ops-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-3456 https://redwood.inc/INC-2026-3456
jon: For the SLO change: propose p95 120ms -> 160ms for a 14d window, then re-evaluate. If error-budget burn >20% after 7d we revert/mitigate. Who signs off?
maria: I'll file the SLO change request and log it in governance tomorrow. Config path I'll update: `/slo/configs/inference-pool-b.yaml` snippet: ```p95: 0.16
window_days: 14```
kevin: Adding dashboard panels and alert rule: `p95 > 0.14` sustained over 3 windows -> page oncall. I'll also attach a small runbook with quick rollback steps.
nash: Noted — will coordinate canary and push the first metrics to the new dashboard.
maria: Action summary: 1) maria — submit SLO change + governance note; 2) kevin — dashboard + alerts + runbook; 3) nash — batch-cap canary on pool-b-low; 4) jon — monitor error-budget and coordinate stop-gap if burn spikes. Target: initial work done in 72h, check-in in 7 days. :thumbsup:
kevin: :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Reminder set: follow-up check-in in 7 days (automated).
